title: Front camera and front-seat access issues
summary: Feedback in this topic centers on front camera problems and front-seat interference with folding the rear entertainment screen, with many fragments too brief or descriptive to assign clear sentiment.

positive.summary: One positive review praises the front desk staff rather than any camera or seat feature.

negative.summary: Negative reviews describe the front camera not working or failing again and disappointment that an advertised camera accessory included only a front camera instead of both front and rear.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention the front camera, front seats, and rear screen folding constraints, but many are too brief or descriptive to confirm sentiment.
